description_snippet:
About the Role:

We are looking for a Product Manager - Digital Transformation with experience in Consumer Durable lending to drive end-to-end digital product journeys across customer onboarding, loan origination, servicing, and collections. The role will focus on digital journey transformation, process re-engineering, automation, STP, and delivering scalable solutions in collaboration with business and technology teams.

Key Responsibilities:

- Own and enhance end-to-end Consumer Durable lending journeys across onboarding, loan origination, servicing, and collections.

- Drive digital journey design, process re-engineering, automation, and Straight-Through Processing (STP) to improve customer experience and turnaround time.

- Translate business requirements into scalable product solutions, functional requirements, user stories, and product roadmaps.

- Manage product backlog, prioritization, sprint planning, Agile/Scrum ceremonies, UAT, releases, and post-production enhancements.

- Work closely with Business, Risk, Operations, Technology, and external partners to deliver digital lending capabilities.

- Drive integrations with LOS, LMS, CRM, APIs, fintech platforms, payment systems, and partner ecosystems.

- Map customer journeys, identify process gaps and drop-offs, and implement improvements across the digital lending lifecycle.

- Define and track product KPIs including conversion, drop-offs, TAT, STP rate, digital penetration, and customer experience metrics.

- Prepare BRDs, user stories, functional specifications, acceptance criteria, and support UAT and release management.

- Manage internal and external stakeholders to ensure timely delivery of product initiatives and integrations.

- Identify opportunities for automation, digitization, and process optimization across lending operations.

Requirements:

- 2 - 7 years of experience in Product Management, Digital Transformation, Digital Lending, or related roles.

- Hands-on experience in Consumer Durable
